affectedSubgraph: system upload route group and its authorization contract
graphChecks.notes: No new package edge; pkg/impexp only gained accessors over existing constants. Sensitive flow reviewed: the upload route's authorization is now pinned by tests on both sides (route group semantics + seed), so moving it into or out of the Casbin group without updating the seed fails the suite.

knownGaps: Human gate pending: the maintainer must confirm the upload permission semantics — /system/upload is deliberately an authenticated capability (TokenAuth + TenantContext, no Casbin) matching the seed; tightening it to e.g. system:setting:upload would require a coordinated frontend + seed change.
The end-to-end unauthorized-upload negative case (no token, 401) is not re-built at handler level; it relies on the existing TokenAuthMiddleware tests.
The i18n suite exceeds a 600s single-command budget, so the run above is the package in isolation (ok 186.9s) rather than one combined command.
